props.name: words
props.description: Possible answers, all the same length. Defaults to a built-in list of five-letter words.

props.name: validGuesses
props.description: Extra words accepted as guesses but never chosen as the answer.

props.name: mode
props.description: `daily` picks the same word for everyone on a date; `random` picks a new one each game.

props.name: date
props.description: The date that picks the daily word. Defaults to today.

props.name: answer
props.description: Fix the answer — for tests and demos. Wins over `mode`.

props.name: hardMode
props.description: Hard mode, controlled. Revealed hints must be used in later guesses.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when the game is won or lost.
